from_notes: Natural Rubber: Elastic, flexible (improved by vulcanisation with S)

from_notes: Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM Act, 2003)
from_notes_src: NextGen Indian Economy Part 1 - APPSC 02 (src/economy/nextgen-indian-economy-p1-appsc-02.txt) p.22
x: The (Union) Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act was enacted in 2003 (26 August 2003) and came into force on 5 July 2004; it is what books call 'the FRBM Act, 2003'. The FRBM Bill was first introduced in Parliament in December 2000, and Andhra Pradesh's own FRBM Act is of 2005, so 2000 and 2005 are traps.
source: NextGen Indian Economy Part 1 APPSC 02 p.22; Rocket Indian Economy (src/economy/rocket-indian-economy.txt) p.30; Ramesh Singh Indian Economy 10th ed. Part 6 (src/economy/ramesh-singh-indian-economy-06.txt) p.19
dispute: Most books and keys: 2003 (year of enactment). Strictly, the FRBM Bill was introduced in Parliament in 2000 and the Act came into force on 5 July 2004 (Ramesh Singh p.19); AP's own FRBM Act is of 2005 (India Code, AP Act 34 of 2005).
evidence: Ramesh Singh 10th ed. Part 6 p.19: FRBM Bill 2000 proposed; FRBMA enacted 26 Aug 2003; in effect 5 Jul 2004
